text: Neurone : for foreign equivalents see NEURON. The unit of nervous structure, NEUROCYTE (q.v.), or nerve-cell, a term free from the ambiguity attending the German form Neuron, and hence preferred by many of the most recent writers, especially in America. See L. F. Barker, The Nervous System (1899), chap. v. ( H.H. )
